name: Yuuki
source:
The AI system I built for the Mariana Orphanage, base on the Universal Key (U-key) door greeter program, hence his name Yuuki. Yuuki's functions are still limited by the original program, as he only perceives commands as doors to be opened and closed.

[In game description]
